as_told.title: Lured craft shot down with EMP/scalar weapons

plain: Secret US programs are said to have lured UFOs into empty airspace and knocked them down with EMP weapons, which fire electromagnetic pulses that disable electronics. Michels says this comes from "an insider leak" about programs recorded on Toughbooks, rugged military laptops, discussed in connection with a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor. He says the programs used temporary flight restrictions, official orders closing an area of sky to other aircraft, to "clear the skies, lure UFOs in, and bring them down." A man named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells a similar story from a man named Jake Barber. Herrera says an organisation sometimes targets the craft with EMP and what he calls "scalar" weapons "and they knock them out of the sky." If true, it would mean the US can bring down these craft on purpose.
